scope: Detailed English accessibility transcript review on macOS/Samantha/rate0.5; chosen for name, role and state agreement in the local corpus
knownLimitations: Raw model invented words on digital silence and a non-speech tone. The observer abstains on digital silence before inference; nonzero noise remains unqualified.
Compare with genuine VoiceOver text and action timing. A mismatch, missing evidence or unexpected speech is inconclusive, not an app pass or fail.
Pronunciation, other voices/rates/languages and mobile readers remain unqualified.
